_comment: Mutation testing for the security-critical auth orchestration module (lib/app-auth.ts: password/passkey/TOTP login, unlock, KDF-preloaded registration). Validates that the tests would CATCH a bug, not just execute the line. Runs in CI (.github/workflows/mutation.yml) only when this module or its tests change. `break` is a RATCHET FLOOR, not the target: the current score is ~92% (556 killed / 43 survived / 4 no-coverage of 603 mutants) after app-auth-mutation.test.ts added exact-value black-box assertions across the JWT-exp/session-refresh, 2FA-provider-parsing, transient-profile, and login/unlock/bootstrap paths — break is set just below that (with margin for CI timeout jitter) to block regressions. Raise it further as the last survivors are killed; drop it only with justification. Same discipline as the coverage ratchet. Run locally: npm run mutation:auth (see reports/mutation/auth.html).
